content.short: Palmera provides multisig smart account infrastructure for organisations running many Safes.
content.description: Palmera targets organisations that have outgrown a single multisig, providing infrastructure to deploy, monitor and operate many Safe-compatible accounts with hierarchy and permissions between them. Hyperliquid's builder documentation lists its Hyperliquid deployment among the Safe multisig instances for the chain. The problem it addresses appears once a DAO or company runs separate treasuries per team and needs consistent policy across all of them.
